newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Polifin signs 100 mln rand deal with EDS.
newsitem.headline: Polifin signs 100 mln rand deal with EDS.

text.p: South African chemicals group Polifin Ltd said on Monday it had signed a five year information technology (IT) deal with U.S. group Electronic Data Systems Inc worth 100 million rand.

The deal with the local arm of the U.S. concern includes the implementation of EDS' SAP R/3 Version 3 information technology system. Two Polifin divisions already use the system and full cover across the group is expected by the end of 1998.
SAP R/3 is expected to reduce stock holdings, lower maintenance costs, improve plant efficiency and process information faster and more accurately, Polifin said.
The deal will also see EDS provide ongoing support and training.
